releases.notes:
Towny-style liquid and machine ownership boundaries.

- Remove the Fluids kingdom toggle and migrate its legacy values automatically.
- Water/lava flow normally within one owner's land and out into wilderness. Incoming wilderness flow and different-owner flow remain blocked at peace. Pouring uses Place permission; collecting uses Break permission.
- Add `preventFluidGriefing` (default true) for flow and dispenser buckets. The old `protectWildernessFromClaimMachines` option is retired.
- Pistons may extend out into wilderness. Retraction still checks ownership before any state changes, and accepted animations finish normally.
- Forbidden dispenser buckets remain in their slot without consumption or fallback ejection. Ordinary projectiles are no longer stopped by a blanket dispenser border check. Protected inventory transfers, core/AirDrop rules and administrator war restrictions remain.

**126 unit tests and 745 dedicated-server checks passed**, including native liquid, bucket, dispenser, dropper and piston operations with C2ME. No graphical client or production server was used.

Stop the server, replace the main **Kingdoms** JAR and restart. Kingdoms Combat does not need replacement.

[Guide](https://github.com/tuledeemon/Kingdoms/wiki/How-Kingdoms-Works)

releases.notes:
Fix claimed-land piston retraction crashes and remove the machine flags.

- Remove `PISTONS` and `AUTOMATION` from settings and commands. Existing configurations, kingdom saves and transaction snapshots migrate automatically, preserving other settings.
- Remove claim-border redstone filtering. Observers can power machines across chunk borders.
- Check the entire piston event before its first block change and let accepted retraction/animation changes finish. Keep ownership-boundary protection, core protection, war placement bans and locked AirDrop chest protection.
- Hoppers, droppers and dispensers work within the same kingdom without a toggle; protected cross-border transfers remain blocked.

Validation: **126 unit tests and 726 dedicated-server checks passed**, including real observer/piston cycles with C2ME. No graphical client or production server was used.

Stop the server, replace the main **Kingdoms** JAR and restart. Kingdoms Combat does not need replacement. Keep one Kingdoms JAR installed.

releases.notes:
Covered cores, artifact repair fixes and 1,000-durability Void Scythe.

- Artifact + ordinary-item repairs preserve the authenticated identity and ability in crafting grids, anvils and grindstones, in either order.
- Combining two artifacts is blocked so neither power is discarded. Ordinary enchantment-removal rules still apply, with built-in Wind Burst preserved.
- Void Scythe now defaults to **1,000 native durability**. Old 10-durability defaults and identities migrate automatically, and authentic existing stacks retain their wear percentage. Other custom durability settings are preserved.
- Placed cores must stay open to the sky. After **five continuous minutes** under any roof, including glass/leaves/fluids, the marker moves to the highest suitable block in the same column. An unsuitable/reserved top gets stone above it. Build-height obstructions warn and retry.
- Owner/holder mayors receive coverage and relocation notices. Timers persist, captured cores retain tribute, carried tokens are exempt, and only loaded chunks are checked. Configure `coreSkyAccessRequired` and `coreCoveredTimeoutSeconds` with `/kingdomadmin set`.

Validation: **122 unit tests and 634 dedicated-server checks**, including actual output clicks, real Vampire healing after repair, and core roof/stone/build-height cases, with C2ME and EconomyCraft. No graphical-client or production-server validation.

Replace the main Kingdoms JAR and restart. This is separate from Kingdoms Combat. Previously stripped identity-less items need an administrator-issued replacement.

[Artifact guide](https://github.com/tuledeemon/Kingdoms/wiki/Artifacts)
